translations.web: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’
translations.bsb: This Jesus is ‘the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.’
translations.kjv: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.
translations.asv: He is the stone which was set at nought of you the builders, which was made the head of the corner.
